purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0227 in the gauge arena: minimal lattice QED on husk squares, exact over the cyclotomic integers: with STAND-IN matter (a static charge and one hopping electron whose crossings the flow records), $Z_N$ links, the electric and plaquette terms as exact unitaries, Gauss holds in every history, the run reverses exactly, and the Clifford (fear-off) limit is the classical integer light mod N point for point.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
